commands.name: init
commands.summary: Create a validated implementation lane, or preview the plan with --dry-run.

commands.name: config
commands.summary: Show resolved lane identity, bindings, paths, and redacted strict configuration.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Validate lane-local markers, configuration, bindings, permissions, Git-ignore coverage, the installed runtime, account access, watcher heartbeat, pack index, coordinator queue/cursor, and operator-session index/turn state without repair; --tui also qualifies the promoted terminal target.

commands.name: list
commands.summary: List Watchtower lanes relevant to the resolved repository without changing lane state.

commands.name: skill
commands.summary: Preview or install the bundled Watchtower coordinator knowledge pack for Codex, Cursor, or Claude.
commands.description: Preview or install the bundled Watchtower coordinator knowledge pack for Codex, Cursor, or Claude.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Report one lane's validated health, runtime observations, events, and conflicts without repair.

commands.name: coordinator
commands.summary: Inspect bounded coordinator projections, run cycle, escalation, index, and specification-resolution operations through the validated effect boundary, and manage operator sessions and bounded questions.
commands.usage: wt coordinator status | wt coordinator context --class=<D1|D2|D3> --trigger=<event-id> | wt coordinator explain [--cycle=<id>] | wt coordinator index <status|verify> | wt coordinator index explain <batch-or-requirement> | wt coordinator index build [--runtime] [--dry-run] | wt coordinator cycle --trigger=<event-id> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator escalate --reason=<text> [--cycle=<id>] [--dry-run] | wt coordinator resolution show <blocker-id> | wt coordinator resolution <propose|resume> <blocker-id> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator resolution sync-check <blocker-id> --worktree=<id> | wt coordinator session --topic=<text> [--policy-profile=<id>] [--stream|--no-stream] | wt coordinator session attach <id> [--observe] [--stream|--no-stream] [--wait-for-active-turn] | wt coordinator session list | wt coordinator session <show|history|export|budget|proposals> <id> [--since=<cursor>] | wt coordinator session <suspend|resume|close|prune|fork|compact> <id> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator session <pin|unpin> <id> <ref> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator session apply <id> <proposal-id> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator session amendment request <id> --pack=<id> --reason=<text> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator session amendment list | wt coordinator session amendment admit <request-id> [--dry-run] | wt coordinator ask --question=<text> --session=<id> [--query-form=<id>]; every form also accepts [--workspace=<path>] [--lane=<slug-or-uuid>] [--initiative=<id>] [--json] [--no-color]

commands.name: events
commands.summary: Read validated durable coordinator events without advancing the cursor.

commands.name: batch
